listing.blurb: A free family play session at Young V&A, the museum for children and families on Cambridge Heath Road. It comes round on the first Saturday of the month, with dates running into early December.

story.who: The sessions are led by Young V&A's Play Champions, according to the museum's own website, and they developed the sessions themselves.
story.now: The museum's own website lists a sensory story drawn from an object in the Adventure gallery, and a session in the Mini Museum in the Play Gallery, a space built around texture, colour and sound.
story.vibe: The museum's own website describes the sessions as relaxed, with tactile and sensory materials to play with together, and designed around parent and child.
worth_knowing: The Mini Museum normally serves children aged 2 and under; for these sessions it welcomes children of every age who have extra sensory needs.
The museum has a visual story with pictures of the building, and its Access page has more information.

evidence.quote: Every first Saturday of the month join Young V&A's Play Champions for a SEND Play session.
This session was developed by the Play Champions and is relaxed and designed with you and your child in mind.
Explore a sensory story inspired by an object from the museum's Adventure gallery with our Play Champions.
Explore the Mini Museum in Young V&A’s Play Gallery, a space that celebrates the texture, colour and sound of objects.
You will be invited to play with tactile and sensory materials, helping to bring the story to life together.
The Mini Museum is usually reserved for children aged 2 and under.
For this inclusive play session, it will be open to children of any age with additional sensory needs.
Our visual story shows you pictures of the museum and how to access our spaces. Please check our Access page for further information.
